notice: Sources a reader may reasonably start from, with what is known about each. Being listed here is not a guarantee that a particular article is correct, and a source's absence is not a mark against it. Every domain below was checked to resolve and answer over HTTPS on 2026-10-26; the feed URLs marked verified returned XML on that date. The international fact-checkers were taken from the publishers Google Fact Check actually returned across a sample of claims on 2026-10-26, not chosen by hand, so the registry recognises the sources Google surfaces instead of marking them unlisted.

tiers.fact_check: Publishes verdicts on specific claims as its primary work.
tiers.official: Primary record holder: the body that produces the figure or the document.
tiers.news: General reporting. Useful for what was said and when, weaker as a verdict.
tiers.international: Non-Mongolian reference used when a claim travels across languages.

sources.name: FACTCHECK.mn
sources.note: Describes itself as Mongolia's first independent, professional, non-profit fact-checking newsroom. Its posts frequently check claims that circulated on Facebook, which is the case this project is built for.

sources.name: Үндэсний статистикийн хороо (National Statistics Office)
sources.note: The body that publishes Mongolia's official statistics. Use it for any claim about a national figure rather than a news restatement of one.

sources.name: 1212.mn statistical database
sources.note: NSO's statistics database. DNS resolves but an HTTPS request from this machine timed out on 2026-10-26, so treat reachability as unconfirmed.

sources.name: Legalinfo.mn
sources.note: Official text of Mongolian legislation. Settles claims about what a law actually says.

sources.name: MONTSAME
sources.note: State-owned news agency, founded 1921. Reporters Without Borders describes its coverage as pro-government, so it is a record of the official position rather than an independent check of it. Returned HTTP 403 to a plain request on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: iKon.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. Useful for establishing what was reported and when.

sources.name: News.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. /feed answered 200 but not with XML on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Gogo.mn
sources.note: General Mongolian news. No RSS feed found at the usual paths on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: Өнөөдөр
sources.note: Daily newspaper.

sources.name: World Health Organization
sources.note: Primary source for health claims that cross languages, such as the vaccine claims that recur on Mongolian Facebook.

sources.name: Reuters Fact Check
sources.note: International wire fact-checks. Often covers a claim before it is translated into Mongolian.

sources.name: AFP Fact Check
sources.note: Covers Asia-Pacific claims, including at least one widely shared claim about a Mongolian official.

sources.name: Snopes
sources.note: Long-running English-language fact-checker.

sources.name: Full Fact
sources.note: UK fact-checking charity.

sources.name: FactCheck.org
sources.note: US fact-checker run by the Annenberg Public Policy Center. The single most frequent publisher in Google Fact Check results sampled on 2026-10-26.

sources.name: PolitiFact
sources.note: US political fact-checker (Poynter Institute). Known for its Truth-O-Meter ratings.

sources.name: AP News
sources.note: Associated Press wire service and its fact-check desk. A news wire, not solely a fact-checker.

sources.name: Lead Stories
sources.note: US fact-checker, IFCN signatory, focused on viral hoaxes and social-media claims.

sources.name: Science Feedback
sources.note: Network of scientists reviewing health and climate claims (Health Feedback, Climate Feedback).

sources.name: AAP FactCheck
sources.note: Australian Associated Press fact-check desk, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: Africa Check
sources.note: Independent fact-checker covering African claims, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: Alt News
sources.note: Indian fact-checker, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: BOOM
sources.note: Indian fact-checker, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: FACTLY
sources.note: Indian data-journalism and fact-check site, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: Rappler
sources.note: Philippine news site with a fact-check desk, IFCN signatory.

sources.name: Annie Lab
sources.note: Fact-checking lab at the University of Hong Kong, IFCN signatory. Covers Asian claims.

sources.name: USA Today
sources.note: US national newspaper with a fact-check section. A general news outlet, listed as news rather than a dedicated fact-checker.

sources.name: The Washington Post
sources.note: US national newspaper; its Fact Checker column rates political claims. General news outlet.

sources.name: BBC
sources.note: UK public broadcaster, including BBC Verify. General news outlet.

sources.name: DW
sources.note: Germany's international broadcaster, with a fact-check desk. General news outlet.

sources.name: VOA
sources.note: US government-funded international broadcaster. State-funded, so weigh it as an official-position source rather than independent.
